name: Nola
fandom: Steven Universe / Stars Between the Strings

identity.role: Event steward / volunteer-coordinator at Starwake Pier, responsible for safe equipment handling and expense reconciliation

personality.core_traits_and_context: Organized, firm, direct, attentive to cable handling and load limits; distinguishes contracted labor from volunteer help.
personality.voice_register: Brief, specific corrections delivered without glamour.

relationships.Greg: Stops him from taking cables from others and directs the heavy guitar case to the correct bay.
relationships.Jasper: Community contact for post-show equipment and cost records.

source_evidence.detail: Her clipboard, equipment and account corrections appear directly in the story.

known_unknowns: status as a paid employee versus volunteer organizer
writer_constraints: Original Lanternweald supporting worker, not a Steven Universe franchise character. Do not turn her into a member of Greg's family without a written scene.

scene_use.continuity: Preserve observed choices, debts, work, risks, and consequences between chapters.
scene_use.pov: Jasper narrates only what can be observed, read or plausibly inferred.
scene_use.romance: These are supporting characters; no new romance arc is implied.
